question: After regressing log|C_t|(t) on mag-derived features, does the residual variance contain a physically-meaningful new signal channel?
hypothesis: The residual of log|C_t|(t) after removing mag_hifi has structure at f_rot / polhode period that mag_hifi cannot capture, i.e. a new signal channel.
narrative_md: Decisive negative: regressing log|C_t|(t) on [mag_hifi, log|dmag/dt|^-1, mag^2] captures R^2=0.681. The 32% residual peaks at 12.99 min (2x f_rot) and 8.26 min (3x f_rot) -- real body-rotation-symmetry harmonics, but already encoded in LC peak-spacing (s007/s008 closed). Not a NEW channel beyond LC features. Uses rotation frequency derived from truth dynamics -- oracle-leak, N=1.
